project_type: Korean-language light-novel content repo (markdown). Goal: configure it as a browsable static site deployable to GitHub Pages so all 9 books are viewable.
language: Korean (한국어) markdown prose, UTF-8. Site UI must set lang=ko and render Korean fonts correctly.
build_system: Static site generator: MkDocs with the Material theme (mkdocs-material). Python 3.9 + pip 26 available. Build with `mkdocs build` -> outputs to ./site. Requirements pinned in a requirements.txt at repo root (or docs/).
test_framework: None (content repo). Verification = building the site successfully with `mkdocs build --strict` and confirming all 9 book indexes + 54 chapter pages render and cross-links resolve.
build_command: python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 -m mkdocs build --strict  (output dir: ./site)
test_command: python3 -m mkdocs build --strict && test -d site && ls site/books
verification_instructions: 1) Install deps from requirements.txt. 2) Run `mkdocs build --strict` and confirm exit 0 (no broken-link/nav warnings). 3) Confirm ./site contains index.html, a page for each of the 9 books, and all 54 chapter pages. 4) Confirm relative .md links from each 00-index.md resolve to built chapter URLs (mkdocs rewrites *.md links natively; --strict fails on unresolved ones). 5) Confirm <html lang="ko"> in generated pages.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The built site (./site) is generated by mkdocs and should NOT be committed (add to .gitignore). GitHub Pages deploy is done by a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and publishes, so no built HTML is checked in.
setup_instructions: No prior setup. Repo at /projects/sandbox/omelas on branch main. Node 22, Python 3.9 (pip 26), Ruby 3.4 available. Network: OPEN_INTERNET (pip installs allowed).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET: pip installs work. IMPORTANT publishing constraint: .github/workflows/*.yml can only be delivered via a PR (orchestrator handles push/PR). Do NOT push or open PRs. The built ./site dir must not be committed.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT modify novel prose or the English originals (README.md, ideation.md, page-1.md). Story bible rule 8 forbids editing English originals. Prefer approaches that leave existing .md files untouched; MkDocs needs no front-matter, so leave all book/chapter files byte-identical. No em dashes in any new content.
key_patterns: 9 books at books/NN-slug/ (01-revelation..09-infancy-gospel). Each book dir: 00-index.md (H1 title '# 오멜라스: <제목> (Omelas: <Title>)', 시놉시스 section, and '## 장 목록' listing chapters via RELATIVE links like [제1장: 강남의 복음](chapter-01.md)) plus chapter-01.md..chapter-06.md (each starts '# 제N장: <title>'). 54 chapters total. MkDocs Material resolves relative .md links natively and needs no front-matter.
relevant_files: mkdocs.yml (to create: site_name, theme material with language ko, nav listing 9 books + chapters, docs_dir pointing at repo content)
.github/workflows/pages.yml (to create: build with mkdocs, deploy to GitHub Pages via actions/deploy-pages)
DEPLOY.md (to create: how to enable Pages + how deploys work)
books/*/00-index.md and books/*/chapter-*.md (content, do NOT modify)
directory_structure: Root: README.md/ideation.md/page-1.md (English, untouched), canon/ (Korean translations + story bible), books/ (9 book dirs each with 00-index.md + 6 chapters). Adding: mkdocs.yml, requirements.txt, DEPLOY.md, .gitignore, .github/workflows/pages.yml.
